 afk Dashboard                                                                                                          
╭───────────────────────────────────────────╮╭─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Sessions                                  ││ feat-auth                                                               │
│     NAME                PHASE     TASKS   ││   Overview   Waves   Stack   Notes   Diff               tab/1-5: switch │
│         ╭─ actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮──────── │
│ ▌ ◐ feat│ type an action's name                                                                            │         │
│   ◐ Bill│                                                                                                  │ng       │
│   ◐ fix-│ go in                               enter  — Go in a level, or open what is selected             │         │
│   ✓ feat│ go back                             esc    — Go back a level, or close what is open              │         │
│   ◐ scra│ jump                                /      — Jump to another project                             │         │
│   ✕ old-│ inbox                               i      — the inbox has not been read yet                     │         │
│         │ details                             d      — Show the selected session's details                 │         │
│         │ read usage                          R      — this dashboard cannot read usage                    │         │
│         │ keys                                ?      — Show every key, level by level                      │         │
│         │ quit                                q      — Leave the dashboard; every session keeps running    │         │
│         │ start a new plan                           — starting a plan is not available here               │         │
│         │ add a project                       +      — works on All projects                               │         │
│         │ remove the project                  -      — works on All projects                               │         │
│         │ answer the oldest                   a      — works on All projects                               │         │
│         │ pause or resume the build           p      — this project has no build                           │         │
│         │ new session                         n      — Start a new session from a plan or a branch         │         │
│         │ one-off session                     o      — Start a one-off session with no plan                │         │
│         │ clean session                       c      — Clean the selected session and its worktree         │         │
│         │ restart agent                       r      — only a stopped or stuck agent can be restarted      │         │
│         │ edit label                          l      — Give the selected session a display label           │         │
│         │ set this task's status              s      — this dashboard cannot change the ledger             │         │
│         │ show this task's tokens             t      — this dashboard cannot read the token ledger         │         │
│         │ mouse                               m      — works in the agent, after ctrl+]                    │         │
│         │ extend the plan                            — Start a planning session that adds work to the plan │         │
│         │ amend the plan                             — Change the plan; asks what to change in a sentence  │         │
│         │ fix a bug                                  — Find and fix a bug; asks what is broken             │         │
│         │ reconcile the plan with a document         — Fit the plan to a document; asks for its path       │         │
│         │ check the plan                             — checking the plan is not available here             │         │
│         │ approve the plan                           — approving is not available here                     │         │
│         ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── type to search · enter runs · esc closes ─╯         │
│                                           ││                                                                         │
│                                           ││                                                                         │
│                                           ││                                                                         │
╰───────────────────────────────────────────╯╰───────────────────────────────────── enter: open · c: clean · l: label ─╯
enter run · ↑/↓ move · type filter · esc close · ctrl+c quit
